_comment: Prompt panel for scripts/agent/ai-visibility-probe.mjs. Read by the ai-visibility task (Tue 03:30).
The panel is the DENOMINATOR of ai_mention_share (docs/agent/metrics.md): every prompt is asked of every
lane, and the metric is the share of answers that name SQL Quest. Changing a prompt changes the metric —
the probe records the panel's sha256 in every output, and the task refuses a week-over-week delta across
a panel change. Edit deliberately, and expect the next read to be a new baseline.
Hard cap: 30 prompts (HARD_MAX_PROMPTS in the probe). 30 x 4 lanes = 120 requests per run is the cost cap.
Three families, EN and TR: practice_where (where do I practise SQL for analyst/data interviews),
alternatives (to DataLemur / StrataScratch / LeetCode SQL / HackerRank SQL), ai_tutor (a site with an AI
tutor, or that explains why my query is wrong). Family and language are reported separately so a swing
in one family reads as what it is. Never put a credential in this file — the probe refuses to run if
_lanes_note: Model ids drift; a lane whose id no longer exists reports status=error with the vendor's message and the other lanes still run. Re-check ids before the first live run and after any vendor deprecation notice.
